title: Person & Digital Footprint Attribution
summary: Build a verified 360-degree profile of an online persona or individual by chaining handle enumeration, email side-channels, breach metadata, and visual cross-verification.

steps.action: Run cross-platform username sweeps and extract structured profile metadata (avatars, bios, user IDs, creation dates).
Check discovered emails/phones against silent registration side-channels and Google/Gravatar ecosystems without triggering reset alerts.
Correlate historical usernames, IP clues, or secondary emails across breach indexes and infostealer telemetry.
Reverse-search profile photos across face/visual indexes to uncover unlinked accounts using different handles.
Hash and archive all confirmed profile pages and plot entity links with confidence ratings.

title: Passive-First Domain & Infrastructure Attribution
summary: Map an organization's external infrastructure, hidden origin IPs behind CDNs, historical ownership, and sister domains without sending a single packet to the target.

steps.action: Query current RDAP and historical WHOIS records to find registrant emails, org names, and reverse-WHOIS sister domains.
Harvest subdomains and wildcard SANs from Certificate Transparency logs and passive DNS aggregators.
Uncover real origin servers behind Cloudflare/WAFs using TLS cert serials, favicon mmh3 hashes, and historical DNS A-records.
Extract Google Tag Manager, Analytics (`G-`/`UA-`), AdSense, or custom JS snippets to discover undisclosed domains run by the same operator.
Pull forgotten endpoints, leaked config files, and old team pages from historical web crawls.

title: Photo & Video Geolocation + Chronolocation
summary: Determine the exact coordinates (geolocation) and capture timestamp (chronolocation) of an unverified photo or video using visual, architectural, geometric, and solar clues.

steps.action: Inspect container metadata (EXIF/XMP/QuickTime atoms), extract keyframes, and search for the earliest public upload on the web.
Identify country/region indicators (license plates, bollards, road markings, utility poles, scripts, bird calls) and generate candidate regions.
Translate visual constraints (e.g., 'gas station within 80m of railway and mosque') into OpenStreetMap Overpass queries.
Confirm exact camera line-of-sight and historical construction changes using 3D terrain, street-level photos, and multispectral satellite time-series.
Measure object height vs. shadow length and azimuth angle to verify or narrow the exact date and local time of capture.

title: Corporate Shell Unmasking, UBO & Sanctions Investigation
summary: Trace complex cross-border corporate hierarchies, uncover Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs), screen against global sanctions/PEP lists, and map physical supply-chain shipments.

steps.action: Locate incorporation filings, company numbers, registered agents, and direct/ultimate parent Legal Entity Identifiers.
Pivot officers, addresses, and intermediaries across leaked offshore corporate registries, court filings, and journalism archives.
Screen entities, directors, vessels, and addresses against consolidated OFAC, EU, UN, UK, and PEP watchlists.
Map real-world buyers, overseas factories, HS commodity codes, and government contracts via bills of lading and tender databases.

title: Cryptocurrency Wallet Attribution & Cross-Chain Tracing
summary: Follow stolen, ransom, or illicit funds across UTXO and EVM blockchains, identify peel chains and cross-chain bridges, and link wallets to off-chain identities or KYC exchanges.

steps.action: Inspect first-funding gas source (faucet/CEX hot wallet), transaction timestamps (activity timezone), and token transfers.
Check 300M+ institutional/community wallet labels, OFAC SDN crypto tags, and scam reports.
Build multi-hop fund-flow graphs, apply UTXO co-spend clustering, and trace DEX/bridge hops to cash-out deposit addresses.
Pivot ENS names, Lens/Farcaster handles, NFT mints, and pasted wallet strings across GitHub, X, Telegram, and darknet indexes.

title: Maritime Vessel, AIS Spoofing & Shadow Fleet Investigation
summary: Investigate suspect cargo vessels or tankers conducting dark-ship port calls, ship-to-ship (STS) transfers, flag-hopping, or sanctions evasion.

steps.action: Resolve MMSI/name to permanent 7-digit IMO number and pull historical flag changes, ISM managers, P&I insurers, and PSC detentions.
Analyze historical AIS tracks, loitering behavior, draught changes (loaded vs. ballast), and transponder gaps.
Use Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (penetrates clouds/night) and Sentinel-2 optical imagery to spot 'dark' ships during AIS blackouts.

title: Military, State & VIP Aircraft Tail-Number Investigation
summary: Track LADD/PIA-blocked executive jets, cargo charters, or military aircraft using unfiltered community ADS-B/MLAT receivers, ACARS datalinks, and aircraft registries.

steps.action: Map tail number to ICAO 24-bit Mode-S hex code, airframe serial number, operator, and FAA/civil trust owner.
Reconstruct live and historical flight legs on unfiltered networks that ignore FAA LADD block requests.
Correlate ramp parking via satellite imagery, ATC audio archives, and regional GNSS jamming interference.

title: Telegram & Discord Network Mapping
summary: Discover, archive, and map interconnected Telegram channels, bots, and Discord servers used by threat actors, fraud rings, or influence operations.

steps.action: Search public channel indexes and Google CSE dorks (`site:t.me`) without joining any group or exposing an account.
Archive channel messages, build Gephi-ready message-forwarding edge lists, and inspect exposed Telegram bot tokens.
Decode Discord Snowflake IDs into exact millisecond creation timestamps, inspect invite metadata, and check leaked server archives.

title: Developer Attribution & Git Repository Forensics
summary: Uncover developer real-world identities, corporate affiliations, timezone habits, and accidentally committed credentials from Git commit histories and public code.

steps.phase: Commit Patch Email & SSH/GPG Key Extraction
steps.action: Append `.patch` to commits or scan commit logs to extract raw author/committer emails, PGP key IDs, and SSH public keys (`github.com/<user>.keys`).
Scan org repos, forks, and dangling commits for leaked secrets, internal hostnames, and unique code patterns.
Pivot discovered project slugs across npm/PyPI/DockerHub maintainers and AWS/Azure/GCP public buckets.

title: Phishing & Malware Infrastructure Pivoting
summary: Triage a suspicious URL, C2 IP, or malware sample and pivot across TLS certificates, JARM fingerprints, DOM hashes, and passive DNS to uncover the actor's entire campaign.

steps.action: Query existing hash, URL, and IP telemetry first before submitting anything new that could tip off the adversary.
Pivot on HTTP body hashes, favicon MurmurHash3 (`mmh3`), JARM TLS fingerprints, and certificate serial numbers to find sibling C2/phishing nodes.
Separate mass internet scanners from targeted attacks and map IOCs to known threat groups and MITRE ATT&CK TTPs.

title: Dark Web, Ransomware & Infostealer Exposure Triage
summary: Assess whether an organization or executive has compromised employee/customer stealer logs, darknet mentions, or active ransomware extortion listings.

steps.action: Query clearnet ransomware victim trackers and darknet indexers without directly visiting hostile extortion `.onion` portals.
Identify infected employee/user devices compromised by RedLine, Lumma, Raccoon, or Vidar infostealers targeting corporate login URLs.
When direct `.onion` inspection is required, execute crawls and triage inside an isolated Tor/Whonix workspace.

title: Wireless BSSID, Cell Tower & RF Signal Intelligence
summary: Geolocate devices, routers, IoT beacons, or radio transmissions by pivoting MAC/BSSID identifiers, cell-tower LAC/CID tuples, and global SDR monitoring nodes.

steps.action: Resolve Wi-Fi BSSID / Bluetooth MAC addresses to hardware manufacturers and historical wardriven GPS coordinates.
Map MCC/MNC/LAC/CID cell tower identifiers to physical tower coordinates and inspect regional GPS/GNSS spoofing zones.
Monitor HF/VHF utility broadcasts via networked Software-Defined Radios and correlate overhead satellite passes.
